secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL, e.g. https://your-project.supabase.co (Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API). A dev placeholder in .env.base44-defaults lets the app boot; the real value is needed for all Supabase-backed pages.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key (Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API). Dev placeholder in .env.base44-defaults; real value needed for all Supabase-backed pages.
